content: प्रमुख {%a.%} .²1 Facing, turning the face towards. .²2 Chief, principal, foremost, first. .²3 Respectable, honourable. .²4 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) .³({%a%}) Headed by, having as chief or at the head; वासुकिप्रमुखाः <ls>Ku. 2. 38</ls>. .³({%b%}) Accompanied with; प्रीतिप्रमुखवचनं स्वागतं व्याजहार <ls>Me. 4</ls>. .{@-खः@} .²1 A respectable man. .²2 A heap, multitude. .²3 The tree called Punnāga. .{@-खम्@} .²1 The mouth. .²2 The beginning of a chapter or section. .²3 The time being, the present. (प्रमुखतस् and प्रमुखे are used adverbially in the sense of ‘in front of’, ‘before’, ‘opposite to’; भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् <ls>Bg. 1. 25</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 22.</ls>).
